lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Of course, I know it's the start of a new semester, so I don't plan on jumping straight into a serious lesson.
Privaty begins a lesson that feels more like an orientation.
Arcana has been resting her chin on her hand, staring at me...
I gesture with my chin to tell her to look forward.
Arcana writes something in her notebook.
She tears off the corner, folds it, and secretly slips it into my hand.
"Meet me at the stairs at the end of the hallway."

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: May I go to the restroom?
Arcana flashes me a smile and leaves the classroom.
May I go to the restroom as well?
I open the classroom door and step into the hallway.
The soft sounds of ongoing lessons drift out from other classrooms.
The stairs at the end of the hallway...
From far away, I see Arcana hopping and waving her hand at me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What did you say to get out of class?
I said I was going to the restroom.
She did look a little displeased...
As we walk down the hallway, Arcana casually takes my hand.
We wander through the quiet school together.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's really quiet when classes are going on.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It almost feels like a completely different place.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You said you don't remember your school days, right? Or your childhood.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Of course. I wrote it down myself in the Volume 1, page 81 of the Counters records.
Why does that feel slightly unnerving...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That's just part of my job.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... I really wanted to experience something like this.
Arcana's grip on my hand tightens ever so slightly.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Skipping class together and wandering around the school.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I really wanted to try that.
Arcana looks up at me and grins.
Ask if there's anything else she wants to do.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh! I was waiting for the right time to do that.
Arcana's fingers fidget slightly against mine.
Is there anything else you want to do?
Arcana shifts her grip, interlocking our fingers.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If I tell you, will you do it with me?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: There's something I've been preparing for a day like this...
Arcana's fingers fidget slightly against mine.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I put it in my right pocket.
... Her right hand is holding my left.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I don't think I can take it out while holding hands.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Can you take it out for me?
But I can't take it out with my right hand either.
Arcana raises our joined hands above our heads,
and slips into the space between my arms.
It ends up looking like I'm hugging Arcana from behind.
From behind, I can see that Arcana's ears are bright red.
I carefully reach into her pocket and pull out the paper inside.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yep. I wrote everything down there.
I unfold the note. At the top, thick pen strokes have crossed something out.
Right below that are the words: "My Youth Bucket List!".
Arcana leans against my chest and points to the middle of the note.
Skipping class and wandering around the school...
Arcana points to the bottom of the note.
then slightly turns her head to look up at me.
... Doesn't this count as something you did?
Arcana turns her head back and looks out the window.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I just wrote those down as they came to mind, so there are some really ridiculous ones.
Arcana releases my hand and turns to face me.
There are quite a lot of things on this list...
After wandering around the school a little longer,
we head back to our classroom, still holding hands as we walk through the quiet hallway.
Skipping out on the very first class would look really bad.
As much as I feel sorry for Arcana, I decide to sit quietly and focus on the lesson.
The classroom door opens, and Arcana returns to her seat, clearly pouting.
It's the first day of class. Skipping it wouldn't look good...
Arcana continues to glare at me, her cheeks puffed in anger.
After thinking about what to do, I open my notebook and place it between our desks.
I take out a pen and begin to write.
Arcana also takes out her pen and writes beneath my sentence.
But judging by how her pen is still hovering over the page...
Maybe our conversation isn't over yet.
Write Arcana's name in the notebook.
Arcana switches the pen to her other hand.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: "If you hold my hand for the rest of class"
"Can I let go after class ends?"
Arcana leans in toward me slightly and whispers in my ear.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: After class, I'm going to ask you to hug me.
Arcana glances sideways at my writing.
She writes my name next to it.
Between our names, she draws a small heart.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: "I've written it countless times while working"
Arcana traces my name, one letter at a time.
She turns her gaze toward me.
Arcana draws an extremely angry-looking emoji.
Next to it, I awkwardly draw a sad emoji.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: "Your handwriting is worse than I thought"
we nearly fill the entire notebook with our conversations.
